tests.desired: A complete, valid case is saved with its address and logged in the audit log
steps: Log in as Data Encoder
Submit a complete dengue case with a pinned address
Read the saved case, address and audit rows
tests.observed: saved as case 34, entered_by 1002, age group 10-14, audit row present, address manual_pin

tests.desired: 100% of invalid records are rejected and none is saved
steps: Submit 16 records, each with one invalid field: missing disease; unknown disease code; invalid classification; missing barangay; barangay outside the city; morbidity week 0; morbidity week 54; year before 2010; negative age; age above 130; sex code not in the list; impossible date; onset date in the future; admission before onset; age group contradicts age; latitude out of range
Check each response and the number of saved cases

tests.desired: A CSV upload saves the valid rows, reports each invalid row by number, and logs every saved row
steps: Upload a CSV of 5 rows: 3 valid, 1 unknown barangay, 1 week 99
Read the response and the audit log

tests.desired: A CSV without the required columns is refused as a whole
steps: Upload a CSV with only two columns
tests.observed: HTTP 422: CSV is missing required columns: case_classification, date_onset, age, sex, outcome, morbidity_week, morbidity_year

tests.desired: Every protected API route refuses a request without a login session
steps: Switch to the production login mode (HRMO token)
Call every protected API route without a token

tests.desired: Every role-restricted route refuses users below its required role
steps: Read the required role of every API route
Call each restricted route as every lower role

tests.desired: Only CESU staff on the authorization list get in; removing someone cuts access at once; refusals are logged
steps: Call the API with a valid HRMO token of an employee who is not CESU staff
Repeat as an authorized Health Analyst
Deactivate the Analyst and repeat
Count ACCESS_DENIED audit rows
tests.observed: non-CESU employee 403, CESU Analyst 200, deactivated Analyst 403, 2 refusals logged

tests.desired: Encoded cases flow through hotspot detection, risk tiering, recommendation and notification without manual steps between modules
steps: As Data Encoder, encode 4 probable dengue cases in Tambo within 60 m of each other, week 35 of 2025
Run hotspot detection with the CESU rule (200 m, 3 cases, 4 weeks)
As Health Analyst, open the risk tiers and recommendations for the week
Run the scheduled alert check
Check the alerts and their delivery
tests.observed: cluster of 4 cases (radius 62 m); Tambo tier High (above epidemic threshold, active hotspot); 7 recommendations, rank 1; alerts: epidemic_threshold + hotspot; 2 emails sent, max 0 s after detection; whole flow 4.3 s
